what: MCP server for Microsoft 365 via Graph: Outlook mail, calendar, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, Excel.
why_michael: One server could give the WhatsApp/Claude assistant read access to his mail, calendar and the 'Safety management' OneDrive folder.
caution: Needs an Entra app registration and Graph scopes; restrict to read/draft scopes to match his M365 write rules.

what: MCP server for Microsoft Graph and Azure APIs, built by a Microsoft employee.
why_michael: Lets an agent query any Graph endpoint (mail, files, Teams) when a dedicated tool is missing.
caution: Very broad Graph access by design; scope permissions tightly.

what: MCP wrapper over the PnP CLI for Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Planner, Power Automate commands).
why_michael: Can list/inspect SharePoint lists and Power Automate flows from an agent instead of clicking in portals.
caution: Runs CLI commands with the signed-in user's rights; destructive commands exist.

what: MCP server for Microsoft Teams: read channels and threads, post messages, mention members.
why_michael: Reading the safety team's Teams channels into agent summaries.
caution: Needs a Teams bot/app registration; his rules make Teams read-only, so disable posting.

what: Microsoft's official catalog of MCP server implementations (Azure, M365-related, Dev tools).
why_michael: Starting point to find officially supported Microsoft servers before choosing a community one.
caution: It is a catalog/monorepo; each server has its own maturity.

what: Official Supabase MCP server: SQL, migrations, logs, advisors, edge functions.
why_michael: Already his DB; can run in read-only, project-scoped mode for the WhatsApp assistant's data questions.
caution: Use --read-only and project scoping; write mode can alter production schema.

what: Token-efficient database MCP server for Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server and more.
why_michael: Lighter alternative for read-only SQL access to the Supabase Postgres from scheduled agents.
caution: Give it a read-only Postgres role, not the service key.

what: Cloudflare's product-specific MCP servers (Workers, observability, AI Gateway, Browser rendering, etc.).
why_michael: Agents could read Pages/Workers logs and AI Gateway usage for his Cloudflare Pages Functions.
caution: Several servers; pick only observability/read ones.

what: MCP server covering the full Cloudflare API (successor to the deprecated bindings server).
why_michael: Single endpoint to manage KV/R2/Workers settings used by his functions.
caution: Full-API token = high privilege; use a narrow API token.

what: MCP server for the official WhatsApp Cloud API: send messages, read conversations, contacts, media.
why_michael: Matches his Meta Cloud API setup, so Claude routines could send template reminders (e.g. certificate expiry) through WhatsApp.
caution: Small project (25 stars); review code before giving it the Meta token.

what: Self-hosted WhatsApp REST API (multi-device web protocol) with webhooks and an MCP mode.
why_michael: Only if he ever needs group features the Cloud API lacks.
caution: Unofficial WhatsApp Web protocol: violates WhatsApp ToS and risks number bans; prefer Cloud API.

what: Kit where Claude Code interviews you and generates a WhatsApp AI agent (Meta Cloud API or Zernio).
why_michael: Reference patterns for a no-code-style WhatsApp agent similar to his.
caution: Spanish-language docs; generated code needs review.

what: MCP server and Claude plugin with Postgres skills and docs to help AI write better SQL.
why_michael: Improves the quality of migrations and queries Claude writes for his Supabase DB.

what: Python tool converting PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images and more to Markdown, with an MCP server.
why_michael: Turn incoming attachments (supplier certificates, procedures) into text the agent can file and summarize.
caution: OCR of scanned pages needs an LLM/vision plugin; plain mode reads text layers only.

what: IBM-originated document parser (PDF layout, tables, OCR) producing LLM-ready output.
why_michael: Better table extraction from scanned inspection reports and permits than plain OCR.
caution: Heavy Python/ML dependencies; runs on a server, not inside Cloudflare Workers.

what: MCP server exposing Docling conversion and document tools to agents.
why_michael: Lets Claude call Docling directly from a routine for PDF-to-structured-data.

what: OCR, layout analysis, reading order and table recognition in 90+ languages.
why_michael: Candidate replacement for Workers AI OCR on scanned Hebrew PDFs (test Hebrew quality first).
caution: Code Apache-2.0 but model weights have a separate restricted license (commercial limits); GPU preferred.

what: Fast PDF-to-Markdown/JSON converter built on Surya, optional LLM boost.
why_michael: Converting long scanned regulation PDFs to Markdown for the knowledge base.
caution: Same model-weights license limits as Surya.

what: Adds a searchable OCR text layer to scanned PDFs (Tesseract-based, supports Hebrew language pack).
why_michael: Make every scanned form in OneDrive searchable before the agent reads it.
caution: Needs Tesseract + 'heb' traineddata installed; RTL text order should be spot-checked.

what: The standard open-source OCR engine with LSTM models for 100+ languages including Hebrew.
why_michael: Free, offline Hebrew OCR baseline to compare against Workers AI.
caution: Weaker on poor scans and mixed Hebrew/numbers than modern VLMs.

what: OCR and document-parsing toolkit (PP-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL) turning PDFs/images into structured data.
why_michael: Structured extraction of tables from scanned checklists.
caution: Hebrew support is weaker than Latin/CJK; see paddleocr-hebrew finetune.

what: PaddleOCR finetunes for Hebrew that also read Latin/digit runs inside RTL text (ONNX).
why_michael: Directly targets his pain point: Hebrew scans with embedded numbers and English (dates, model numbers).
caution: Very new and tiny (5 stars); validate accuracy on his own scans.

what: Dockerized Flask web app/HTTP API wrapping Tesseract OCR for images and PDFs in multiple languages.
why_michael: Simple self-hosted OCR endpoint a routine could call; author is an Israeli developer.
caution: Small project; Tesseract quality limits apply.

what: MCP server letting agents create and edit Excel files (formulas, charts, formatting) without Excel installed.
why_michael: Generate monthly KPI/incident spreadsheets from Supabase data.

what: MCP server for reading and editing .docx with track changes, comments and structural validation.
why_michael: Edit controlled Word forms while keeping tracked changes for document control (ISO 7.5).
caution: Small project (65 stars).

what: Agent skills that learn existing Word/PowerPoint/Excel templates and generate on-brand documents from them.
why_michael: Produce committee decks and controlled forms that keep the Tapugan template exactly.
caution: Check RTL/Hebrew handling on his templates.

what: Agentic framework that generates PowerPoint decks with reflection, from documents and reference slides.
why_michael: Draft safety-committee presentations from the month's data and a reference deck.
caution: Research-grade; Hebrew RTL not documented.

what: TypeScript PDF generation library with a WYSIWYG template designer and form fields.
why_michael: Design a fixed PDF form template once, then fill it from Supabase in a Cloudflare function (pure JS).
caution: Hebrew needs an embedded Hebrew font; verify RTL rendering.

what: Docker API converting Word/Excel/PowerPoint/HTML/Markdown to PDF (LibreOffice + Chromium) and merging PDFs.
why_michael: Convert generated Word forms to signed-off PDFs automatically.
caution: Needs a container host (not Cloudflare Pages).

what: Memory layer for AI agents (user/session memories, vector + graph backends, MCP).
why_michael: Let the WhatsApp assistant remember each worker's preferences and past reports across chats.
caution: Self-host or paid cloud; store no sensitive personal data without policy.

what: Temporal knowledge-graph framework for agent memory with an MCP server.
why_michael: Track how facts change over time (e.g. who holds which certificate until when).
caution: Needs Neo4j/FalkorDB; more infrastructure.

what: AI memory platform that builds knowledge graphs plus vector search from documents.
why_michael: Build a queryable memory over procedures, risk surveys and past incidents.

what: Simple, fast graph-based RAG framework (supports Postgres/pgvector storage).
why_michael: RAG over legislation and internal procedures, can store in his Supabase Postgres.
caution: Answer quality in Hebrew depends on the embedding model chosen.

what: Platform for stateful agents with long-term self-editing memory.
why_michael: Alternative backbone for a persistent assistant that learns Michael's routines.
caution: Full platform, large migration from his current setup.

what: Shared memory for multiple AI agents with hybrid search, versioning and audit, over MCP/CLI/HTTP; Supabase or Docker.
why_michael: Runs on Supabase, so his several scheduled agents could share one audited memory.
caution: Very small (19 stars); young project.

what: Local Markdown-file knowledge base that AI assistants read and write via MCP.
why_michael: Human-readable memory notes he can also open himself.
caution: AGPL-3.0 (copyleft if modified and served).

what: CLI to test prompts, agents and RAG with assertions, plus red-teaming.
why_michael: Regression tests for the WhatsApp assistant's Hebrew answers (e.g. 'never invent a law section').

what: Open-source LLM tracing, evals, prompt management and cost tracking.
why_michael: See every assistant conversation, tool call and its cost in one dashboard.
caution: License 'Other': MIT core with commercial 'ee' folders; self-host needs Postgres + ClickHouse, or use cloud.

what: Pytest-style LLM evaluation framework with many metrics (faithfulness, hallucination).
why_michael: Score whether legislation answers are grounded in the retrieved Nevo text.

what: Open-source platform to debug, evaluate and monitor LLM apps and agent workflows.
why_michael: Alternative to Langfuse for tracing routines and running evaluations.

what: Python framework for input/output validators (PII, format, toxicity) around LLM calls.
why_michael: Block the assistant from sending personal medical data or malformed outputs.
caution: Python only; his functions are JS.

what: Toolkit for programmable conversational guardrails (topics, jailbreak, fact-check rails).
why_michael: Keep the WhatsApp bot on safety topics and refuse off-topic requests.
caution: License 'Other' (Apache-based with notices); Python-heavy.

what: Python SDK for agent monitoring, LLM cost tracking and session replay.
why_michael: Cost tracking per scheduled agent.
caution: Mainly cloud dashboard.

what: Fast local token and cost tracker for LLM usage such as Claude Code.
why_michael: Quick view of how many tokens his Claude Code routines spend.
caution: Small project.

what: Anthropic's community plugin marketplace for Claude Code and Cowork (read-only mirror).
why_michael: Trusted place to find plugins (skills, hooks, MCP bundles) to add to his sessions.
caution: Community plugins vary in quality; read each before enabling.

what: Cloudflare's official agent skills for building on Workers, Pages, D1, R2, AI.
why_michael: Improves Claude's work on his Cloudflare Pages Functions.

what: Large multi-harness plugin marketplace of agents, skills and commands for Claude Code and others.
why_michael: Ready subagents (e.g. code review, security audit) for the repo's routines.
caution: Mostly developer-oriented.

what: CLI to install and monitor Claude Code agents, commands, hooks, MCPs and settings.
why_michael: One-command install of vetted hooks/MCP configs and a usage monitor.

what: Curated list of Claude Code skills, hooks, commands, plugins and tools.
why_michael: Discovery list to find more tools later.
caution: License 'Other' (custom); it is a list, not a tool.

what: Curated Claude Code plugin marketplace (Superpowers skills: planning, TDD, debugging).
why_michael: Proven workflow skills for long multi-step tasks.
caution: Developer-workflow focused.

what: Rust safety hook that blocks destructive shell, git and filesystem commands before they run.
why_michael: Extra safety net beside his own guard hooks (guard-sql.py etc.).
caution: License 'Other' (custom, check terms).

what: Workflow automation platform with AI agent nodes, 400+ integrations, MCP support.
why_michael: Visual flows for WhatsApp -> Supabase -> Outlook draft, as a Power Automate complement.
caution: Sustainable Use License (fair-code, not OSI); self-host or paid cloud.

what: MCP server that gives Claude knowledge of n8n nodes so it can build n8n workflows.
why_michael: Claude could build/repair n8n flows for him instead of him clicking.
caution: Only useful if he adopts n8n.

what: Open-source automation platform with AI agents and ~400 pieces exposed as MCP servers.
why_michael: Self-hostable alternative to Power Automate with built-in MCP for Claude.
caution: License 'Other': MIT community edition plus commercial EE folder.

what: Platform for durable background jobs, schedules and AI agent workflows in TypeScript.
why_michael: Reliable retries for long OCR/filing jobs that time out in Cloudflare functions.
caution: Requires TypeScript code; cloud or self-host.

what: SDK to build stateful AI agents on Cloudflare Workers with scheduling, state and MCP.
why_michael: Native fit: scheduled agents and WhatsApp webhook agent on the platform he already uses.
caution: Needs Workers (Durable Objects), not just Pages Functions.

what: Declarative workflow orchestrator (YAML) with schedules, triggers and AI plugins.
why_michael: Central scheduler for all routines with history and retries.
caution: Heavier JVM infrastructure.

what: Persistent Claude Code agents with scheduling, sessions, memory and Telegram.
why_michael: Pattern for always-on scheduled Claude Code agents with chat control.
caution: Small project; Telegram not WhatsApp.

what: MCP server for Israel Government open data (data.gov.il CKAN).
why_michael: Pull official Israeli datasets (e.g. registries, hazardous materials permits if published) into answers.
caution: Small project; dataset coverage varies.

what: Advanced MCP server for Israeli Government Open Data (data.gov.il).
why_michael: Same use as above with more tools; actively maintained.
caution: Small project; review before use.

what: Codebase of ivrit.ai, the open Hebrew speech dataset and Whisper-based Hebrew ASR models.
why_michael: Transcribe Hebrew WhatsApp voice notes from workers into text reports.
caution: Model hosting needed (GPU/RunPod or HF); data/model licenses are separate from code.

what: Zero-dependency TypeScript client for Dicta's free Nakdan API (automatic Hebrew vocalization).
why_michael: Add niqqud to Hebrew text for TTS or ambiguous terms in training material.
caution: Tiny project; depends on an external free API.

what: Hebrew-first RAG for legal documents with hybrid retrieval, cross-lingual reranking and citations.
why_michael: Design reference for grounded Hebrew answers over Israeli safety regulations.
caution: Tiny project; license 'Other' (check terms).

what: Git history of Israeli law, one commit per law taking effect.
why_michael: Possible source to detect new or amended regulations alongside Nevo.
caution: Tiny, early ('sources so far'); license 'Other'.

what: MCP server for PubChem: compounds, properties, safety/hazard data and cross-references.
why_michael: Look up GHS hazard data for chemicals in the plant (cleaning agents, refrigerants) when reviewing SDSs.
caution: Small project; PubChem is not a substitute for the supplier SDS.

what: Agent skill that evaluates emergency/fire drill scenarios against OSHA, NFPA and ISO 45001.
why_michael: Template for an agent that reviews drill reports against criteria.
caution: Tiny; US standards, not Israeli regulations.

what: Self-assessment scorecard tool for ISO 45001, risk, incidents and compliance.
why_michael: Idea source for an ISO 45001 gap-assessment checklist.
caution: Tiny (1 star); not an agent tool.

what: QHSE agent skill for OpenCode covering ISO 9001, 14001:2026, 45001 (French, Senegal/West Africa rules).
why_michael: Example of structuring an ISO 14001/45001 skill; content not Israeli.
caution: Tiny; license 'Other'; French and non-Israeli regulations.
